https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06133

该论文证明了在异构预填充与解码长度下最小化LLM服务总延迟是NP难问题，并提出Sorted-F算法，通过F度量平衡批次规模与下游解码成本，实现了常数因子近似保证。

arXiv:2508.06133v5 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：我们研究了在固定KV缓存内存预算下大型语言模型（LLM）服务的离线调度问题，其中请求具有异构的提示（预填充）长度和响应（解码）长度。给定时刻零点已到达的一批积压请求，调度器需随时间构建混合预填充/解码批次，以最小化总端到端延迟。我们证明提示长度的异构性从根本上改变了问题的性质：最小化总延迟是NP难问题，且优先考虑短输出或小总序列长度的标准策略可能具有无界的近似比。我们提出Sorted-F算法，它反复使用一种F度量来选择可行批次，该度量在批次规模与下游解码成本之间取得平衡。在精确批次选择下，Sorted-F在单位时间、无中断解码且输出长度已知的模型中实现了常数因子近似保证；该保证在静态峰值内存批次约束下同样成立。

arXiv:2508.06133v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study offline scheduling for large language model (LLM) serving under a fixed KV-cache memory budget, where requests have heterogeneous prompt (prefill) and response (decode) lengths. Given a backlog of requests available at time zero, the scheduler forms mixed prefill/decode batches over time to minimize total end-to-end latency. We show that heterogeneity in prompt lengths fundamentally changes the problem: minimizing total latency is NP-hard, and standard policies that prioritize short outputs or small total sequence sizes can have unbounded approximation ratios. We propose Sorted-F, which repeatedly selects feasible batches using an F-metric that balances batch cardinality against downstream decode cost. With exact batch selection, Sorted-F achieves a constant-factor approximation guarantee in the unit-time, uninterrupted-decoding model with known output lengths; the guarantee also holds under a static peak-memory batch

item.title: 本文首次完整建立了量子认知机器学习（QCML）的矩阵几何框架及其数学基础，将数据编码为希尔伯特空间中的量子几何，直接从数据导出内蕴维度、量子度规与贝里曲率等几何拓扑结构，并提出矩阵拉普拉斯算子作为避免维度灾难、保持几何性质的图嵌入替代方法。
item.description:
数据的量子几何

Quantum Geometry of Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21135

本文首次完整建立了量子认知机器学习（QCML）的矩阵几何框架及其数学基础，将数据编码为希尔伯特空间中的量子几何，直接从数据导出内蕴维度、量子度规与贝里曲率等几何拓扑结构，并提出矩阵拉普拉斯算子作为避免维度灾难、保持几何性质的图嵌入替代方法。

我们展示了量子认知机器学习如何将数据编码为量子几何。在QCML中，数据的特征由学习得到的厄米矩阵表示，数据点被映射为希尔伯特空间中的态。量子几何描述为数据集赋予了丰富的几何与拓扑结构——包括内蕴维度、量子度规和贝里曲率——这些均直接从数据中导出。QCML能够捕捉数据的全局性质，同时避免了局部方法固有的维度灾难。本工作首次完整阐述了QCML作为一个矩阵几何框架，建立了其数学基础，并演示了如何将量子几何中的算符级工具直接应用于数据。我们引入了矩阵拉普拉斯算子及其特征映射，作为保持几何性质的图嵌入替代方案，并展示了如何将切尔类等拓扑不变量应用于数据。

arXiv:2507.21135v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate how Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML) encodes data as quantum geometry. In QCML, features of the data are represented by learned Hermitian matrices, and data points are mapped to states in Hilbert space. The quantum geometry description endows the dataset with rich geometric and topological structure---including intrinsic dimension, quantum metric, and Berry curvature---derived directly from the data. QCML captures global properties of data, while avoiding the curse of dimensionality inherent in local methods. The present work provides the first full exposition of QCML as a framework for \emph{matrix geometry}, establishing its mathematical foundation and demonstrating how operator-level tools from quantum geometry can be directly applied to data. We introduce the matrix Laplacian and its eigenmaps as a geometry-preserving alternative to graph-based embeddings, and we show how topological invariants such as Che

item.title: 提出了Squeeze10-LLM分阶段混合精度训练后量化框架，通过将80%权重量化为1比特、20%量化为4比特实现平均每权重1.6比特（即16比特权重压缩10倍），并借助二值化后激活鲁棒性（PBAR）和全信息激活监督（FIAS）两项创新在极端压缩下保持模型性能。
item.description:
Squeeze10-LLM：通过分阶段混合精度量化方法将大语言模型权重压缩10倍

Squeeze10-LLM: Squeezing LLMs' Weights by 10 Times via a Staged Mixed-Precision Quantization Method

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18073

提出了Squeeze10-LLM分阶段混合精度训练后量化框架，通过将80%权重量化为1比特、20%量化为4比特实现平均每权重1.6比特（即16比特权重压缩10倍），并借助二值化后激活鲁棒性（PBAR）和全信息激活监督（FIAS）两项创新在极端压缩下保持模型性能。

部署大语言模型（LLM）因其庞大的参数量和高昂的计算成本而面临巨大挑战。超低比特量化可以显著减少存储需求并加速推理，但极端压缩（即平均比特宽度≤2）通常会导致严重的性能下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Squeeze10-LLM，有效地将16比特大语言模型的权重“压缩”10倍。具体而言，Squeeze10-LLM是一个分阶段混合精度的训练后量化（PTQ）框架，通过将80%的权重量化为1比特、20%的权重量化为4比特，实现了平均每权重1.6比特的压缩。我们引入了Squeeze10-LLM的两项关键创新：二值化后激活鲁棒性（PBAR）和全信息激活监督（FIAS）。PBAR是一种精细化的权重重要性度量指标，它考虑了量化对激活的影响，从而提高了低比特设置下的准确性。FIAS是一种保留完整激活信息的策略……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2507.18073v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) is challenging due to their massive parameters and high computational costs. Ultra low-bit quantization can significantly reduce storage and accelerate inference, but extreme compression (i.e., mean bit-width <= 2) often leads to severe performance degradation. To address this, we propose Squeeze10-LLM, effectively "squeezing" 16-bit LLMs' weights by 10 times. Specifically, Squeeze10-LLM is a staged mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) framework and achieves an average of 1.6 bits per weight by quantizing 80% of the weights to 1 bit and 20% to 4 bits. We introduce Squeeze10LLM with two key innovations: Post-Binarization Activation Robustness (PBAR) and Full Information Activation Supervision (FIAS). PBAR is a refined weight significance metric that accounts for the impact of quantization on activations, improving accuracy in low-bit settings. FIAS is a strategy that preserves full ac

item.title: 提出TaskPGM框架，将任务建模为马尔可夫随机场，利用单任务微调模型间的行为差异刻画任务亲和性，自动学习最优的连续任务混合比例，在监督微调中平衡覆盖度与冗余度，从而更高效地分配训练预算。
item.description:
从任务亲和性学习任务混合：一种用于监督微调的概率图模型

Learning Task Mixtures from Task Affinities: A Probabilistic Graphical Model for Supervised Fine-Tuning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12612

提出TaskPGM框架，将任务建模为马尔可夫随机场，利用单任务微调模型间的行为差异刻画任务亲和性，自动学习最优的连续任务混合比例，在监督微调中平衡覆盖度与冗余度，从而更高效地分配训练预算。

大型语言模型的监督微调性能在很大程度上取决于训练预算如何分配到异构的任务集合上。在实践中，任务混合比例通常采用简单的启发式方法（如均匀采样或按数据规模成比例采样）来固定，这些方法忽略了任务之间的相互作用，可能会损害迁移效果，并将预算浪费在冗余的数据源上。我们提出了TaskPGM，一个通过基于能量的模型学习连续任务混合比例的框架。任务构成马尔可夫随机场中的节点：一元势能刻画每个任务的个体效用，成对势能则利用从单任务微调模型的预测分布计算出的行为差异（如Jensen–Shannon散度和逐点互信息）来编码任务间的关系。对该目标进行优化所得到的任务混合比例能够在覆盖度与冗余度之间取得平衡。我们证明了所得的集合函数在预算约束下是弱次模的……

arXiv:2507.12612v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning performance for large language models depends strongly on how training budget is distributed across a heterogeneous set of tasks. In practice, mixtures are often fixed using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant sources. We introduce TaskPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures via an energy-based model over tasks. Tasks form the nodes of a Markov random field: unary potentials capture per-task utility, and pairwise potentials encode inter-task relationships using behavioral divergences computed from predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models (e.g., Jensen--Shannon divergence and pointwise mutual information). Optimizing this objective yields mixtures that balance coverage against redundancy. We show that the resulting set function is weakly submodular under budget co

item.title: 本文提出了一种测量模型输出随输入变化而改变概率的“响应性”方法，并提供了统计算法和框架，用于提升模型在动态环境中的安全性与可靠性。
item.description:
响应性验证：预测会改变吗？改变多少？多久改变一次？

Responsiveness Verification: Will Predictions Change? How Much? How Often?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02169

本文提出了一种测量模型输出随输入变化而改变概率的“响应性”方法，并提供了统计算法和框架，用于提升模型在动态环境中的安全性与可靠性。

arXiv:2507.02169v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：机器学习模型通常被应用于其输入因日常交互、策略性操纵或噪声而发生变化的场景中。在这些情境下，模型可能因这些变化导致其在未见过的输入空间区域进行预测，从而削弱安全性。我们提出通过测量响应性——即模型输出在交互模型下随输入变化而改变的概率——来应对这些挑战。我们开发了用于估计任何机器学习模型响应性的算法，以及一个用于指定广泛类别交互模型的框架。我们将这些算法与支持实际验证的统计保证相结合。我们展示了我们的工具如何通过检测累犯预测中的排斥现象、估算内容审核中博弈的成本，以及测试大型语言模型基准的稳健性，来促进各领域的安全性和可靠性。

arXiv:2507.02169v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning models are often used in applications where their inputs change due to routine interactions, strategic manipulation, or noise. In such settings, models can undermine safety as these changes lead them to predict over regions of input space they have not seen. We propose to address these challenges by measuring responsiveness---the probability that a model output changes when its inputs change under an interaction model. We develop algorithms to estimate responsiveness for any machine learning model, and a framework to specify broad classes of interaction models. We pair these algorithms with statistical guarantees that support practical validation. We demonstrate how our tools can promote safety and reliability across domains by detecting preclusion in recidivism prediction, estimating the cost of gaming in content moderation, and testing the robustness of benchmarks for LLMs.

item.title: 本文研究表明，在积分制奖励计划中，对客户类型采用统一阈值且不随时间提高阈值的一致性策略成本有限，因此实践中出于运营和客户信任考虑而保持一致性的做法在经济上是合理的。
item.description:
论积分制奖励计划中一致性的有限成本

On The Limited Cost of Consistency In Points-Based Rewards Programs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.03911

本文研究表明，在积分制奖励计划中，对客户类型采用统一阈值且不随时间提高阈值的一致性策略成本有限，因此实践中出于运营和客户信任考虑而保持一致性的做法在经济上是合理的。

基于积分的奖励计划是激励客户忠诚度的一种普遍方式。理论上，这些计划的有效设计受两个重要因素影响：客户异质性表明，针对不同客户类型定制（积分兑换）阈值可能带来收入增益；而需求不确定性则促使卖家随着对客户反应的逐步了解而随时间更新阈值。然而在实践中，在这两个维度上保持一致性可能带来不可忽视的运营和客户体验方面的好处。为所有客户类型设置单一阈值可以促进透明沟通，并降低与个性化定价相关的法律、声誉和运营风险；而避免提高阈值则可防止客户已积累积分的贬值。基于这些考虑，本文研究了积分制奖励计划中保持一致性的成本。

arXiv:2506.03911v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Points-based rewards programs are a prevalent way to incentivize customer loyalty. In theory, the effective design of these programs is shaped by two important considerations. Customer heterogeneity suggests that tailoring thresholds to different customer types may yield revenue gains, while demand uncertainty creates incentives to update thresholds over time as the seller learns how customers respond to the program. In practice, however, there may be nontrivial operational and customer-facing benefits associated with maintaining consistency along both of these dimensions. Setting a single threshold across customer types can facilitate transparent communication and reduce the legal, reputational, and operational risks associated with personalization, while avoiding threshold increases prevents the devaluation of customers' previously earned points. Motivated by these considerations, this paper studies the cost of consistency in point

item.title: 该论文首次为标准Clip-SGD在重尾噪声和 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下的凸优化中建立了高概率收敛保证，避免了对 $L_1R_0$ 的指数级依赖，其界对失败概率仅有多对数级依赖。
item.description:
重尾噪声与 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下裁剪SGD的高概率收敛性

High-Probability Convergence of Clipped SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise and $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20817

该论文首次为标准Clip-SGD在重尾噪声和 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下的凸优化中建立了高概率收敛保证，避免了对 $L_1R_0$ 的指数级依赖，其界对失败概率仅有多对数级依赖。

梯度裁剪被广泛应用于语言模型训练中以控制重尾梯度噪声，并且在 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下能够比随机梯度下降（SGD）提供更好的收敛保证。在这些联合条件下，一个核心挑战是获得高概率保证且避免对 $L_1R_0$ 的指数级依赖，其中 $R_0$ 限定了初始点到极小值点的距离。我们针对凸目标函数解决了这一挑战，据我们所知，首次为标准Clip-SGD建立了此类保证。我们假设无偏随机梯度具有有界的中心 $\alpha$ 阶矩，其中 $\alpha\in(1,2]$。我们的界对失败概率的倒数仅有多对数级依赖，并且在噪声消失时能够恢复已知的确定性广义平滑速率，在经典 $L$-平滑设置下的重尾噪声情形中也能恢复标准的高概率速率。该凸速率是可以达到的。

arXiv:2505.20817v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Gradient clipping is widely used in language-model training to control heavy-tailed gradient noise and can improve convergence guarantees over stochastic gradient descent (SGD) under $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness. Under these joint conditions, a central challenge is to obtain high-probability guarantees without exponential dependence on $L_1R_0$, where $R_0$ bounds the initial distance to a minimizer. We resolve this challenge for convex objectives, establishing, to the best of our knowledge, the first such guarantees for standard Clip-SGD. We assume unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded central $\alpha$-th moment, $\alpha\in(1,2]$. Our bounds have only polylogarithmic dependence on the inverse failure probability and recover known deterministic generalized-smoothness rates when the noise vanishes, as well as the standard high-probability rate under heavy-tailed noise in the classical $L$-smooth setting. The convex rate is attain

item.title: DimGrow是一种无需内存密集型超级网络的轻量级嵌入维度搜索方法，通过重要性评分从单维度起步逐步扩展或收缩各特征字段的嵌入维度，在保证推荐效果的同时显著降低训练内存。
item.description:
DimGrow：内存高效的特征字段级嵌入维度搜索

DimGrow: Memory-Efficient Field-level Embedding Dimension Search

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12683

DimGrow是一种无需内存密集型超级网络的轻量级嵌入维度搜索方法，通过重要性评分从单维度起步逐步扩展或收缩各特征字段的嵌入维度，在保证推荐效果的同时显著降低训练内存。

关键特征字段需要更大的嵌入维度，而其他字段则需要更小的维度，这就要求自动化的维度分配。现有方法，如剪枝或神经架构搜索（NAS），需要训练一个内存密集型的超级网络来枚举所有可能的维度组合，这对于大规模特征空间来说是不可行的。我们提出了DimGrow，这是一种轻量级方法，摆脱了对超级网络的需求。DimGrow从每个特征字段一个维度开始训练模型，通过重要性评分逐步扩展或收缩维度。只有当维度的重要性持续超过阈值时才会增长，从而确保内存效率。在三个推荐数据集上的实验验证了DimGrow的有效性，同时与基于超级网络的方法相比，它降低了训练内存。

arXiv:2505.12683v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Key feature fields need bigger embedding dimensionality, others need smaller. This demands automated dimension allocation. Existing approaches, such as pruning or Neural Architecture Search (NAS), require training a memory-intensive SuperNet that enumerates all possible dimension combinations, which is infeasible for large feature spaces. We propose DimGrow, a lightweight approach that eliminates the SuperNet requirement. Starting training model from one dimension per feature field, DimGrow can progressively expand/shrink dimensions via importance scoring. Dimensions grow only when their importance consistently exceed a threshold, ensuring memory efficiency. Experiments on three recommendation datasets verify the effectiveness of DimGrow while it reduces training memory compared to SuperNet-based methods.

item.title: 本文提出ICNN增强的两阶段随机规划方法，利用输入凸神经网络在架构上强制凸性并通过线性规划实现精确推理，从而摆脱对混合整数规划中整数变量的依赖，显著提升求解效率。
item.description:
ICNN增强的两阶段随机规划：利用输入凸神经网络求解两阶段随机规划问题

ICNN-enhanced 2SP: Leveraging input convex neural networks for solving two-stage stochastic programming

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.05261

本文提出ICNN增强的两阶段随机规划方法，利用输入凸神经网络在架构上强制凸性并通过线性规划实现精确推理，从而摆脱对混合整数规划中整数变量的依赖，显著提升求解效率。

两阶段随机规划（2SP）为不确定性条件下的决策建模提供了基础框架，但由于追索函数求值的计算复杂性，其可扩展性仍然是一个挑战。现有的基于学习的方法，如Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming（Neur2SP），采用神经网络（NN）作为追索函数的代理模型，但依赖于计算开销高昂的混合整数规划（MIP）公式。我们提出了ICNN增强的2SP方法，该方法利用输入凸神经网络（ICNN）来挖掘凸2SP问题中线性规划（LP）的可表示性。通过在架构上强制保证凸性并借助LP实现精确推理，我们的方法消除了传统基于MIP的公式中固有的整数变量需求，同时将ICNN代理模型精确地嵌入到2SP框架中，从而带来了计算效率更高的方案。

arXiv:2505.05261v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Two-stage stochastic programming (2SP) offers a basic framework for modelling decision-making under uncertainty, yet scalability remains a challenge due to the computational complexity of recourse function evaluation. Existing learning-based methods like Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming (Neur2SP) employ neural networks (NNs) as recourse function surrogates but rely on computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations. We propose ICNN-enhanced 2SP, a method that leverages Input Convex Neural Networks (ICNNs) to exploit linear programming (LP) representability in convex 2SP problems. By architecturally enforcing convexity and enabling exact inference through LP, our approach eliminates the need for integer variables inherent in the conventional MIP-based formulation while retaining an exact embedding of the ICNN surrogate within the 2SP framework. This results in a more computationally efficient altern

item.title: 提出“因果片段”新概念来分析脉冲神经网络，证明片段内输出脉冲时间对输入和参数局部Lipschitz连续，且因果片段数量可作为衡量SNN逼近能力的有效指标。
item.description:
因果片段：逐片分析和改进脉冲神经网络

Causal pieces: analysing and improving spiking neural networks piece by piece

https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14015

提出“因果片段”新概念来分析脉冲神经网络，证明片段内输出脉冲时间对输入和参数局部Lipschitz连续，且因果片段数量可作为衡量SNN逼近能力的有效指标。

我们提出了“因果片段”，这是一个用于分析脉冲神经网络（SNN）的新概念，其灵感来源于人工神经网络（ANN）中用于研究表达能力和可训练性的“线性片段”。因果片段将具有单脉冲编码的前馈SNN的输入和参数空间划分为不同的区域，在每个区域中，相同的子网络导致输出脉冲的产生。对于由具有大膜时间常数的基于电流的泄漏积分发放（LIF）神经元构成的网络，我们证明了在每个因果片段内，输出脉冲时间相对于输入和网络参数是局部Lipschitz连续的。我们进一步证明了依赖于因果片段数量的逼近误差下界。因此，因果片段的数量是衡量SNN逼近能力的一个度量指标，该指标在脉冲时间不连续的情况下仍然有效，并且适用于同时具有兴奋性和抑制性突触的网络。

arXiv:2504.14015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce "causal pieces", a novel concept for analysing spiking neural networks (SNNs), inspired by "linear pieces" used to study expressivity and trainability in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Causal pieces partition the input and parameter space of a feedforward SNN with single-spike coding into distinct regions where the same subnetwork causes the output spikes. For networks of current-based leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with large membrane time constants, we show that within each causal piece, output spike times are locally Lipschitz continuous with respect to inputs and network parameters. We further prove a lower bound on the approximation error that depends on the number of causal pieces. Thus, the number of causal pieces is a measure of the approximation capabilities of SNNs, which is valid despite spike-time discontinuities and applies to networks with both excitatory and inhibitory synapses. item.title: 该论文提出弹性字典学习网络，首次验证了字典结构能够在强自适应对抗攻击下可靠地提升深度学习模型的对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力。
item.description:
利用字典结构提升对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力

Boosting Adversarial Robustness and Generalization with Dictionary Structure

https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.00834

该论文提出弹性字典学习网络，首次验证了字典结构能够在强自适应对抗攻击下可靠地提升深度学习模型的对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力。

本工作研究了一种通过在深度学习模型设计中引入结构先验来提升对抗鲁棒性和泛化能力的新方法。具体而言，我们的研究令人惊讶地发现，现有的受字典学习启发的卷积神经网络（CNN）虽然对随机噪声具有鲁棒性，但仍然极易受到对抗攻击的影响。为解决这一问题，我们提出了弹性字典学习网络，这是一种新颖的ResNet架构，能够显著增强对抗鲁棒性和泛化能力。大量且可靠的实验表明，该方法在多个数据集、骨干网络架构和威胁模型下均实现了一致的对抗鲁棒性提升。据我们所知，这是首个发现并验证字典结构能够在强自适应攻击下可靠地增强深度学习鲁棒性的工作，为未来研究开辟了一个有前景的方向。

arXiv:2502.00834v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work investigates a novel approach to boost adversarial robustness and generalization by incorporating structural prior into the design of deep learning models. Specifically, our study surprisingly reveals that existing dictionary learning-inspired convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are robust against random noise but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. To address this, we propose Elastic Dictionary Learning Networks (EDLNets), a novel ResNet architecture that significantly enhances adversarial robustness and generalization. Extensive and reliable experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in adversarial robustness across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and threat models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to discover and validate that dictionary structure can reliably enhance deep learning robustness under strong adaptive attacks, unveiling a promising direction for future resear

item.title: 本文在温和正则条件下证明，Bregman散度（即 $g$-Bregman/rho-tau 散度）是唯一能实现干净偏差-方差分解的连续非负损失函数类，从而回答了此类分解的充要条件问题。
item.description:
偏差-方差分解：Bregman散度的专属特权

Bias-variance decompositions: the exclusive privilege of Bregman divergences

https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.18581

本文在温和正则条件下证明，Bregman散度（即 $g$-Bregman/rho-tau 散度）是唯一能实现干净偏差-方差分解的连续非负损失函数类，从而回答了此类分解的充要条件问题。

偏差-方差分解被广泛用于理解机器学习模型的泛化性能。虽然平方误差损失允许一个直观 straightforward 的分解，但其他损失函数——例如0-1损失或 $L_1$ 损失——要么无法使偏差与方差之和等于期望损失，要么其所依赖的定义缺乏有意义偏差和方差应具备的基本性质。最近的研究表明，对于更广泛的Bregman散度类（交叉熵损失作为其特例），可以实现“干净”的分解。然而，这类分解的充要条件仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们在温和的正则性条件下，通过研究满足不可分辨同一性（当且仅当两个参数相同时损失为零）的连续、非负损失函数来回答这一问题。我们证明了所谓的 $g$-Bregman 散度或 rho-tau 散度

arXiv:2501.18581v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bias-variance decompositions are widely used to understand the generalization performance of machine learning models. While the squared error loss permits a straightforward decomposition, other loss functions - such as zero-one loss or $L_1$ loss - either fail to sum bias and variance to the expected loss or rely on definitions that lack the essential properties of meaningful bias and variance. Recent research has shown that clean decompositions can be achieved for the broader class of Bregman divergences, with the cross-entropy loss as a special case. However, the necessary and sufficient conditions for these decompositions remain an open question. In this paper, we address this question by studying continuous, nonnegative loss functions that satisfy the identity of indiscernibles (zero loss if and only if the two arguments are identical), under mild regularity conditions. We prove that so-called $g$-Bregman or rho-tau divergences

item.description:
TeD-Loc：面向弱监督目标定位的文本蒸馏

TeD-Loc: Text Distillation for Weakly Supervised Object Localization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12632

TeD-Loc通过对比学习将CLIP文本嵌入的知识蒸馏到patch嵌入中，在不引入条件去噪和复杂提示学习等额外机制的情况下，实现更完整、更精准的弱监督目标定位。

弱监督目标定位（WSOL）模型能够在无需显式边界框标注的情况下，同时预测目标的类别及其对应的空间区域。由于依赖于分类目标，传统的WSOL方法（如类激活映射）往往只关注目标最具判别性的区域，常常遗漏目标完整的空间范围。尽管CLIP等视觉-语言模型编码了丰富的语义先验，但其全局的文本嵌入和类别词元嵌入并未与局部图像块（patch）嵌入显式对齐，从而限制了patch级别的定位能力。诸如GenPrompt等近期方法虽然解决了这一局限，但代价是复杂度增加，因为它们依赖条件去噪和复杂的提示学习策略。在本文中，我们提出了面向定位的文本蒸馏方法TeD-Loc，该方法通过对比（学习）将CLIP文本嵌入中的知识蒸馏到patch嵌入中……

Given their reliance on classification objectives, traditional WSOL methods, like class activation mapping, tend to focus on the most discriminative object regions, often missing the full spatial extent. Although vision-language models like CLIP encode rich semantic priors, their global text and class-token embeddings are not explicitly aligned with local patch embeddings, limiting patch-level localization. Recent methods such as GenPrompt address this limitation, but at the cost of increased complexity, as they rely on conditional denoising and elaborate prompt-learning strategies. item.title: 本文提出用凸物理信息神经网络求解Monge-Ampère方程，通过凸神经网络结构保证解的凸性并特别在损失函数中处理传输边界条件，从而有效近似最优传输映射。
item.description:
用于Monge-Ampère最优传输问题的凸物理信息神经网络

Convex Physics Informed Neural Networks for the Monge-Amp\`ere Optimal Transport Problem

https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10162

本文提出用凸物理信息神经网络求解Monge-Ampère方程，通过凸神经网络结构保证解的凸性并特别在损失函数中处理传输边界条件，从而有效近似最优传输映射。

将原材料从供应商运输到客户的最优运输是物流领域中出现的问题，本文采用基于最优传输理论的连续模型来解决该问题。本文提倡使用物理信息神经网络方法来求解相应的广义Monge-Ampère方程。为强制Monge-Ampère方程解的凸性并获得最优传输映射的合适近似，本文采用了凸神经网络。研究特别关注在损失函数中对传输边界条件的强制执行。数值实验展示了多种配置下最优传输问题的求解结果，并进行了敏感性分析。

arXiv:2501.10162v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Optimal transportation of raw material from suppliers to customers is an issue arising in logistics that is addressed here with a continuous model relying on optimal transport theory. A physics informed neural network method is advocated here for the solution of the corresponding generalized Monge-Amp\`ere equation. Convex neural networks are advocated to enforce the convexity of the solution to the Monge-Amp\`ere equation and obtain a suitable approximation of the optimal transport map. A particular focus is set on the enforcement of transport boundary conditions in the loss function. Numerical experiments illustrate the solution to the optimal transport problem in several configurations, and sensitivity analyses are performed.

Learning Nonlinear Finite Element Solution Operators using Multilayer Perceptrons and Energy Minimization

我们开发并评估了一种用于学习由偏微分方程（PDE）所支配的非线性问题解算子的方法。该方法基于有限元离散化，旨在利用多层感知机（MLP）来表示解算子，该感知机以问题数据变量作为输入，并输出对有限元解的预测。这些变量通常对应于输入数据参数化中的参数，例如边界条件、系数和右端项。其输出为相应有限元解的近似，从而在理论和实践上均可获得标准有限元方法（FEM）的支持与增强。我们专注于使用与偏微分方程相对应的能量泛函作为损失函数，因为这使我们能够制定高效的、可并行化的训练算法，该算法基于在每个单元上局部组装能量……

arXiv:2412.04596v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop and evaluate a method for learning solution operators to nonlinear problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). The approach is based on a finite element discretization and aims at representing the solution operator by a multilayer perceptron (MLP) that takes problem data variables as input and gives a prediction of the finite element solution as output. The variables will typically correspond to parameters in a parametrization of input data such as boundary conditions, coefficients, and right-hand sides. The output will be an approximation of the corresponding finite element solution, thus enabling support and enhancement by the standard finite element method (FEM) both theoretically and practically. item.description:
基于上下文信息的信贷市场多任务动态定价

Multi-Task Dynamic Pricing in Credit Market with Contextual Information

https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.14839

该论文提出了一种利用证券间共享结构与上下文信息的多任务动态定价框架，以解决信贷市场场外交易中因交易稀疏和透明度不足导致的数据匮乏问题，帮助经纪商在竞争性报价环境中高效学习获胜价格。

我们研究了经纪商所面临的动态定价问题，该经纪商试图为大量信贷市场证券（如公司债券、政府债券、贷款及其他信贷相关证券）学习定价。为这些证券定价的一个主要挑战源于其交易不频繁以及场外（OTC）市场缺乏透明度，这导致针对单个证券的定价数据不足。尽管如此，许多证券之间存在可加以利用的结构相似性。此外，经纪商常常下小额“试探性”订单来推断竞争对手的定价行为。利用这些洞察，我们提出了一个多任务动态定价框架，该框架利用证券之间的共享结构来提高定价准确性。在场外市场中，经纪商通过提供比竞争对手更具竞争力的报价来赢得交易。经纪商的目标是在最小化相对于全知者的预期遗憾的同时，学习获胜价格。

arXiv:2410.14839v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the dynamic pricing problem faced by a broker seeking to learn prices for a large number of credit market securities, such as corporate bonds, government bonds, loans, and other credit-related securities. A major challenge in pricing these securities stems from their infrequent trading and the lack of transparency in over-the-counter (OTC) markets, which leads to insufficient data for individual pricing. Nevertheless, many securities share structural similarities that can be exploited. Moreover, brokers often place small "probing" orders to infer competitors' pricing behavior. Leveraging these insights, we propose a multi-task dynamic pricing framework that leverages the shared structure across securities to enhance pricing accuracy. item.title: 该论文提出一种利用V(D)J重组生成的预选择TCR库作为自然实验来校正未观察混杂因素的方法，结合半参数层次因果模型与置换不变神经网络，从观察性TCR测序数据中推断T细胞受体序列对患者疾病预后的因果效应。
item.description:
估计T细胞受体的因果效应

Estimating the Causal Effects of T Cell Receptors

https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.14127

该论文提出一种利用V(D)J重组生成的预选择TCR库作为自然实验来校正未观察混杂因素的方法，结合半参数层次因果模型与置换不变神经网络，从观察性TCR测序数据中推断T细胞受体序列对患者疾病预后的因果效应。

人类免疫学的一个核心问题是患者的T细胞受体如何影响疾病。在此，我们提出一种方法，利用观察性TCR测序数据和临床结果数据来推断T细胞受体（TCR）序列对患者预后的因果效应。我们的方法利用患者的预选择TCR库来校正未观察到的混杂因素，例如患者的环境和生活史。这种预选择库由一个程序化的随机重组过程——V(D)J重组——生成，这提供了一个自然实验。我们首先推导出一个因果识别结果，利用生物学理论以半参数方式约束层次因果模型，从而实现因果推断。然后，我们开发了一种因果估计策略，该策略使用置换不变神经网络和表示学习，可扩展到来自数百名患者的数百万条序列。

arXiv:2410.14127v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A central question in human immunology is how a patient's T cell receptors impacts disease. Here, we introduce a method to infer the causal effects of T cell receptor (TCR) sequences on patient outcomes using observational TCR sequencing data and clinical outcomes data. Our approach corrects for unobserved confounders, such as a patient's environment and life history, using the patient's pre-selection TCR repertoire. This pre-selection repertoire is generated by a programmed stochastic recombination process, V(D)J recombination, which provides a natural experiment. We first derive a causal identification result that leverages biological theory to semiparametrically constrain a hierarchical causal model, enabling causal inference. We then develop a causal estimation strategy that uses permutation invariant neural networks and representation learning to scale to millions of sequences from hundreds of patients. BadRAG：识别大语言模型检索增强生成中的漏洞

https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.00083

BadRAG揭示了一种针对检索增强生成系统的新型攻击：攻击者通过向知识库注入恶意文段，当用户查询包含特定触发词时即可操纵系统响应，且无需修改用户输入或模型权重。

检索增强生成（RAG）通过从外部知识库检索相关信息来增强大语言模型（LLM），从而提供更准确、更具上下文感知且更加及时的回答。然而，这种对外部知识的依赖引入了重大的安全漏洞，因为许多RAG系统（例如Google搜索）依赖于庞大且未经清洗的数据存储库（例如Reddit）。在本文中，我们揭示了一种新型威胁：攻击者通过向RAG系统的知识库注入恶意文段来操纵系统的响应。当用户的查询包含攻击者指定的触发词时，RAG会检索并引用这些恶意文段，使攻击者能够在不修改用户输入或RAG权重的情况下操纵响应。BadRAG分为两个阶段：（i）对恶意文段进行优化，使其仅在用户查询中出现触发词时才会被检索；（ii）这些恶意文段……

arXiv:2406.00083v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases to provide more accurate, contextually informed, and up-to-date responses. However, this reliance on external knowledge introduces significant security vulnerabilities, as many RAG systems (e.g., Google Search) rely on large and unsanitized data repositories (e.g., Reddit). In this paper, we unveil a novel threat in which attackers steer the RAG system's response by injecting malicious passages into its knowledge base. When a user's query contains attacker-specified trigger words, the RAG retrieves and refers to these malicious passages, enabling the attacker to steer the response without altering the user input or modifying the RAG weights. item.title: 本文为风险敏感强化学习提出了一种新的分布式策略梯度框架，推导了累积成本概率测度的解析梯度，并设计了基于分类分布逼近的CDPG算法及其逼近与收敛性保证。

关于风险敏感强化学习中分布式策略梯度算法的逼近与收敛性研究

On the Approximation and Convergence of Distributional Policy Gradient Algorithms for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14749

本文为风险敏感强化学习提出了一种新的分布式策略梯度框架，推导了累积成本概率测度的解析梯度，并设计了基于分类分布逼近的CDPG算法及其逼近与收敛性保证。

风险敏感强化学习（RL）对于在高风险应用中保持可靠性能至关重要。传统RL方法旨在学习随机累积成本的点估计，而分布式RL则寻求估计其整个分布，从而为处理不同风险度量提供了统一的框架。然而，为风险敏感分布式RL开发策略梯度方法本质上更为复杂，因为它通常涉及求概率测度的梯度。本文为风险敏感RL引入了一种新的分布式策略梯度框架，其中我们推导了累积成本概率测度的解析梯度。为了实际实现，我们进一步设计了一种分类分布式策略梯度算法（CDPG），该算法使用支撑在固定点上的分类分布族来逼近任意分布。利用条件风险价值（CVaR）……

arXiv:2405.14749v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) is crucial for maintaining reliable performance in high-stakes applications. While traditional RL methods aim to learn a point estimate of the random cumulative cost, distributional RL seeks to estimate the entire distribution of it, leading to a unified framework for handling different risk measures. However, developing policy gradient methods for risk-sensitive distributional RL is inherently more complex as it often involves finding the gradient of a probability measure. This paper introduces a new distributional policy gradient framework for risk-sensitive RL, where we derive an analytical gradient of the probability measure of the cumulative cost. For practical implementation, we further design a categorical distributional policy gradient algorithm (CDPG) that approximates arbitrary distributions using a categorical family supported on fixed points. item.description:
MONOVAB: 用于孟加拉语多标签情感检测的注释语料库

MONOVAB : An Annotated Corpus for Bangla Multi-label Emotion Detection. (arXiv:2309.15670v1 [cs.LG])

http://arxiv.org/abs/2309.15670

这个研究构建了一个基于孟加拉语的注释语料库，用于多标签情感检测。通过使用基于上下文的方法以及BERT模型，填补了这一学科领域的空白。

近年来，情感分析(SA)和情感识别(ER)在孟加拉语中越来越流行，孟加拉语是世界上第七大使用人数最多的语言。然而，孟加拉语的结构复杂，这使得准确提取情绪变得困难。在这个研究领域中，已经采用了一些不同的方法，例如提取积极和消极情感以及多类情绪。然而，在这种语言中提取多种情绪几乎是未开发的领域，它涉及基于一段文本识别出多种情感。因此，本研究展示了一种基于从Facebook上抓取的数据构建注释语料库的详细方法，以填补这个学科领域的空白，克服挑战。为了使这种注释更有成果，采用了基于上下文的方法。转换器中的双向编码器表示(BERT)。

In recent years, Sentiment Analysis (SA) and Emotion Recognition (ER) have been increasingly popular in the Bangla language, which is the seventh most spoken language throughout the entire world. However, the language is structurally complicated, which makes this field arduous to extract emotions in an accurate manner. Several distinct approaches such as the extraction of positive and negative sentiments as well as multiclass emotions, have been implemented in this field of study. Nevertheless, the extraction of multiple sentiments is an almost untouched area in this language. Which involves identifying several feelings based on a single piece of text. Therefore, this study demonstrates a thorough method for constructing an annotated corpus based on scrapped data from Facebook to bridge the gaps in this subject area to overcome the challenges.
